blocks.text: Rapper and singer-songwriter Kiyo takes center stage in a new music-focused campaign, “Rumdam,” exploring how friendships and self-expression shape the experiences of young Filipinos. The artist, whose real name is Yukihiro Rubio, is featured in the video for “Rumdam,” which draws inspiration from the Filipino word “ramdam” and its association with emotions. Known for his distinct blend of indie hip-hop and R&B, Kiyo first gained recognition in the OPM underground scene before making his way into the mainstream.
